items.description: A card that proves an email: six boxes on one real input (paste and autofill work) that check themselves on the last digit, wave while checking, and turn success or shake and clear, with a resend countdown and a title that rolls with the result
items.docs: Docs: https://notchset.dev/components/verify-code-block · Agent prompt: https://notchset.dev/md/verify-code-block.md · For the full notchset look, also add @notchset/notchset (tokens and fonts). · Needs React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4 (Tailwind 3 projects: upgrade first, see https://notchset.dev/docs/installation).

meta.useWhen: verification code, otp, one-time code, 2fa, confirm email, two-factor
